purpose: Counterexample to unconditional START-cell painting refusal; task-level objective semantic bit, host authority unchanged

training.method: frozen 23-feature GAL011 base plus 3 trained cross-entropy imitation adapter weights

objectives: START not in target (32 cell strict ink budget)
START in target (33 cell strict ink budget)

conclusions: Unconditional refusal to paint START is unsafe as a general policy when the objective requires painting START; 0/32 included-goal tasks versus 32/32 when task-conditional.
Conditional guard gives 32/32 completion in both task semantics with frozen greedy weights on these narrow synthetic corridors.
Genuinely trained adapter made no additional greedy completion gain beyond frozen conditional guard; negative result retained.
Stochastic adapter retained failures: 27/32 START-excluded and 22/32 START-included; deterministic decoding is a material confound.
The policy receives a public START-objective bit, not a privileged goal map. A precise host-provided task semantic is therefore required before applying such conditional filters.
limitations: Only path/tree synthetic corridors, 32 or 33 cells, strict ink budget; no comb/deep_tree transfer
